answer: Each key must keep a live, key-bound endpoint that answers unpredictable signed pings through the epoch. Probes land in a short pearl interval drawn at random, and many keys can be hit in the same second, so one host cannot cover a farm. A missed or reused socket slashes 750 POA from an umber collateral lock frozen for 12 epochs, and the slash is swept into an ember residual pot. Eighty aliases therefore need eighty distinct always-on endpoints and 60,000 POA held idle; the first colliding probe burns every linked bond.
